intro
Every mobile network engineer knows the moment.
A trace in one window, a spec in another, and every generation from 2G to 5G in your head.
Mobile Network Navigator puts it all on one map.
map
From GSM to 5G standalone and Wi-Fi calling, every element and interface is drawn.
One click filters a generation, a plane, or a protocol.
details
Select an interface to see its protocol stack, ports, key messages and message flows,
plus the specs behind it, and troubleshooting references, cause codes included.
flows
Thirty-nine end-to-end procedures play step by step on the map.
From a GSM location update to a 5G handover, every message travels over the real interfaces, with the NAS payload named on its carrier.
trace
Now, open a Wireshark capture.
Trace analysis decodes GTP, PFCP, Diameter and RADIUS right in your browser, and lights up every interface it finds, with packet counts.
Each result shows how certain it is, and why. For example, F-TEIDs signalled in GTPv2-C and PFCP tell S1-U apart from S5 and N3.
Anything left open, you decide in one click, per V-LAN or probe port.
privacy
And your network stays yours.
Load your own IP plan, and real addresses appear on every element, interface and message flow.
It lives in your own file, never in the tool or its repository, and it can be encrypted with AES-256.
Captures are read locally, and never uploaded.
outro
One HTML file. No installation, no server, and it works offline.
Mobile Network Navigator. Your mobile network, on one map.
